notes.title: Chaos Knight New Version Content
notes.content:
Update content:

1. Add a new spirit hero - the goddess of reincarnation.

2. Add activities related to the reincarnation goddess: Hero Arrival, Advanced Battle Order, Growth Gift Pack, Hero Reward, Limited Time Soul Box, and Limited Time Shopping Mall.

3. New skin system: can be viewed in the hero information section, and a tailor shop has been added to the benefits to sell skin

4. Add a VIP exclusive gift package

5. Add daily first charge

6. Add Black Gold Weekly Card (open on the 8th day of registration)

7. New exciting activities: Brave Trials, Skin Sale (open on the second day of registration), Continuous Charge Rewards, Start Server Recharging, Brave Tower (open on the 8th day of service opening), Consumption Gift (open on the 8th day of registration), Limited Time Redemption (open on the 8th day of registration), Adventure Diary (open on the 8th day of registration)

8. New Secret Realm Gold Hunting Activity (open on the 5th day of registration): Secret Realm Gold Hunting, Daily Compliance, Secret Realm Store

9. New Hero Festival Event (open on the 8th day of registration): Greetings for check-in, limited time summoning, limited time shopping mall, and event accumulation

10. Add exclusive evolution activities (open on the 11th day of registration): exclusive check-in, exclusive tasks, exclusive shopping mall, exclusive puzzle

11. New Team Challenge: After reaching a certain level in battles and the Tower of Thrones, multiple team challenges are required to complete the level

12. Redo of Poisonous Hero Skill 4: Changed to additional damage based on the enemy's current health value

13. Adjusting the content of the beginner gift package

14. Hero Gathering Activity Rewards and Condition Adjustment

15. Optimization of Heat Ranking Calculation Method

16. Add different colored apertures at the feet of enemy units in the formation interface to represent the hero level

17. Add activity expiration reminder

18. Optimization of red dot prompts in some systems
